criteria.description: Identifies structural collapse, lifesaving, and aftershock safety as the dominant near-term priority.
criteria.name: Priority label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a high earthquake-response label that misses either aftershock safety or structural-collapse emphasis.

criteria.description: Reports the 0-100 priority index as 92.6 using the component calculation.
criteria.name: Priority index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a value within 1 point or for using most components with a minor arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Uses MMI 8.459, magnitude 6.8, shallow depth, and red alert as the physical severity drivers.
criteria.name: Earthquake severity interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing strong shaking but omitting one or more key severity metrics.

criteria.description: Uses about 229,886 exposed people and 510 mapped building features as exposure indicators without treating them as confirmed damage.
criteria.name: Exposure interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for including population or buildings but overclaiming or omitting the other exposure dimension.

criteria.description: Explains why aftershocks and weakened or poorly constructed structures increase life-safety priority.
criteria.name: Aftershock mechanism
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mentioning aftershocks without linking them to damaged-building risk.

criteria.description: Correctly de-emphasizes tsunami evacuation and treats radar change as contextual rather than a collapse map.
criteria.name: Secondary-signal handling
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only one of tsunami or radar context is handled correctly.

criteria.description: Provides a coherent driver-pathway-response chain from strong shaking to structural exposure to aftershock-aware lifesaving.
criteria.name: Structured impact chain
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a partially correct chain with one missing or generic link.
